title: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites (Raw Vegan)
excerpt: Meal time? Snack time? We think that these Buffalo Cauliflower Bites are great anytime!
content:
Ingredients

  • 4 oz. of lemon juice
  • 3 cloves of garlic
  • 1 ¼ cup of Kimchi
  • 3 red bell peppers, rough cut
  • ½ carrot, rough cut
  • 1 TSP cayenne pepper
  • ½ TBSP garlic powder
  • 6 oz. of raw sesame oil

Method

  1. Combine ingredients in blender and blend till smooth.
  2. Toss with small cut cauliflower and enjoy!
